State-owned Coal India Limited (CIL) has released a notification for an internship program under the Prime Minister's Internship Scheme, offering training and a stipend across multiple corporate and field locations. Online registration for the program is scheduled to commence on November 2, 2026.

Operated under the Ministry of Coal, Government of India, CIL manages coal mining, production, and sales operations. Selected participants will undergo training directly at company facilities, gaining practical exposure to corporate workflows and administrative functions.

Program Structure and Key Dates

The initiative offers a total of 50 internship openings across designated positions. According to the official schedule, the application window opens on November 2, 2026, and closes on December 2, 2026.

Available positions and locations include:

  • Office Intern (Secretarial Practice): CIL Headquarters, Kolkata (10 seats)
  • Office Intern (COPA): CIL Headquarters, Kolkata (15 seats)
  • Office Assistant (Steno Hindi): CIL Headquarters, Kolkata (05 seats)
  • Office Intern (Secretarial Practice): North Eastern Coalfields, Margherita, Assam (01 seat)
  • Office Intern (COPA): North Eastern Coalfields, Margherita, Assam (10 seats)

Eligibility and Selection Criteria

The program is open to candidates who have completed their 12th-grade education, alongside applicants holding ITI certificates, diplomas, graduate degrees, and post-graduate qualifications. Selection will be based on academic qualifications and marks rather than a written examination. Successful candidates will receive a stipend as per the guidelines of the Prime Minister's Internship Scheme.

Practical Implications and Verification

Interested applicants can apply online through the official portal at pminternship.mca.gov.in. Candidates are required to register on the platform, generate a login, locate the CIL internship listing, and complete the form with accurate educational details and required documents before the December 2, 2026 deadline. Readers should verify official notifications directly via the designated government portal for any updates regarding eligibility criteria or submission guidelines.
